description: This Java source file defines the `SerialPortEvent` class, which models events related to serial port communication in the jSSC library. It includes constants for different event types, member variables for port name, event type, and event value, as well as accessor methods and boolean checks for specific event types.

classes.name: SerialPortEvent
classes.description: Represents an event occurring on a serial port, such as data reception, status lines change, or errors. It provides methods to identify event types and retrieve event details.

methods.name: SerialPortEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new serial port event with the given port name, event type, and event value.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port associated with the event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the integer code representing the type of the event.

methods.name: getEventValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the event, context-dependent based on event type.

methods.name: isRXCHAR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXCHAR (data received).

methods.name: isRXFLAG
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXFLAG (input buffer bytes count).

methods.name: isTXEMPTY
methods.description: Checks if the event type is TXEMPTY (output buffer empty).

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks if the event type is CTS (Clear To Send signal).

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is DSR (Data Set Ready signal).

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RLSD (Received Line Signal Detect).

methods.name: isBREAK
methods.description: Checks if the event type is BREAK (break condition).

methods.name: isERR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is ERR (error).

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RING (ring indicator).
